question.text: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)
question.resolution_criteria: Each subquestion will resolve as the maximum intraday value of the VIX recorded from the market open on the first Monday to the market close on the last Friday of the specified biweekly period. Specifically, it will resolve as the highest HIGH value for the relevant days in the CSV published [on the Cboe website](https://www.cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_historical_data/).
question.fine_print:
* If the market is closed on one or more trading days within the period, only the available trading days will be considered.
* If the resolution source delays or ceases its reporting of these data, Metaculus might use alternative [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) to resolve this question.

research:
I couldn't find any prediction market on the VIX for these dates. The latest close is 25.64 (Fri Nov 6) and the 2026 year-to-date high so far is 28.36 (Nov 5). Neither date falls inside the Nov 9 - Nov 20 window, so nothing is settled yet.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-07: The Cboe VIX_History.csv (cdn-api.cboe.com) runs up to 11/06/2026. The last row is Open 27.68, High 27.76, Low 23.47, Close 25.64. [Cboe CSV](https://cdn-api.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VIX_History.csv)
- 2026-11-05: The CSV row is Open 17.14, High 28.36, Low 16.70, Close 28.18. [Cboe CSV](https://cdn-api.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VIX_History.csv)
- One source conflict: Cboe's product page showed 24.77 (-12.10%) for Nov 6, but the CSV and Yahoo both say 25.64. [search summary](https://www.cboe.com/tradable-products/vix/), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EVIX/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet; the window opens Mon Nov 9. The VIX starts the window at about 25.6, after an 8-month high of 28.36 on Nov 5.
- Nov 9 - Nov 20 has 10 normal trading days and no US market holidays (Thanksgiving is Nov 26).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-06: Stocks bounced partly. Most reports have the S&P 500 up about 0.3% at about 7,377 and the Nasdaq up about 1.1%. The SOX chip index rose 4.2% and the Nikkei fell 5.9% into a bear market. For the week, the S&P fell about 2.7% and the Nasdaq about 3.4%. One report says the 10-year yield rose to 4.85%. [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/stocks-tech-sell-off-nasdaq-correction-dow/), [BNN Bloomberg](https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/markets/dow-jones/2026/11/06/wall-street-stocks-in-relief-rally-after-heavy-ai-related-selloff/)
  - The IBTimes article in your news feed says the S&P fell 4.36% on Nov 6. That conflicts with the rebound reports and with the VIX falling 9%, so it probably describes Nov 5. [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/us-stocks-ai-semiconductor-selloff-nasdaq-correction-1830555)
- 2026-11-06: Taiwan's index fell almost 9% intraday, its largest intraday drop on record. [UDN](https://udn.com/news/story/7251/9861110)
- 2026-11-05: The AI and chip trade unwound, reportedly on fears that Democratic midterm wins would bring AI regulation or slower data-center spending. The Nasdaq fell about 5.5% into a correction, and it was the S&P's worst day since April 2025. The VIX jumped 11.75 points, its largest intraday jump in over 18 months. Vanda Research saw the biggest retail net selling since March 2020. [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/wall-street-fear-gauge-soars-as-retail-traders-bolt-amid-market-rout/article71671752.ece), [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-november-5-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-plunge-chip-stocks-melt-down-193726491.html)
- 2026-10-30 to 11-03: Intraday highs were 23.93, 21.77 and 21.91. On Nov 4 the VIX closed at 16.61, the day after the election. [Cboe CSV](https://cdn-api.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VIX_History.csv)

## 4. Base rates
All figures below are from the Cboe CSV.
- **2026 regime:** August to mid-October mostly traded between 14 and 18. Spikes since then: 22.31 (Oct 16), 20.66 (Oct 23), 23.93 (Oct 30) and 28.36 (Nov 5).
- **Recent spikes faded:**
  - The two weeks after the Oct 16 spike to 22.31 peaked at 20.66.
  - Nov 2-3, after the 23.93 high, peaked at 21.91.
  - The 28.36 high came about 2 days after a 16.61 close.
- **Same window, prior years:**
  - 2025, Nov 10-21: the prior close (Nov 7) was 19.08. The window high was 28.27 on Nov 20, the day after Nvidia earnings, about +48% versus the prior close. The opening day's high was 18.82.
  - 2024, Nov 11-22: the prior close was 14.94 and the window high was 18.79 (Nov 20), about +26%.
  - The CSV excerpt I read did not include 2022-2023.
- **Seasonality:** In both 2024 and 2025 the VIX rose mid-November, peaking around Nov 20 near Nvidia earnings and options expiry.
- **This year:** The starting level (25.64) is well above both prior years (19.08 and 14.94).
- **Reading the window high:** It can't fall below the first day's high, which will likely be near or above Monday's opening level unless the VIX gaps down sharply.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold markets on the VIX level for this period. None of the markets you collected match: they cover CPI, gas, the dollar index, silver and similar.
- The Kalshi market on November CPI is about December data, not the Nov 10 release.
- I also could not find any expert VIX forecasts for this window.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **2026-11-10 (Tue) 8:30 ET:** October CPI. The BLS calendar also lists the October jobs report that day. One news report already cited payrolls of +165k on Nov 6, so the jobs release date is uncertain. [BLS schedule](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/11_sched.htm), [BLS CPI](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm?force_isolation=true)

- **2026-11-17 (Tue):** October PPI. [BLS schedule](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/11_sched.htm)
- **Nvidia Q3 FY2027 earnings:** Sources disagree on the date.
  - Nov 17 after the close, per CMElite, which says Nvidia confirmed it on Oct 28. [CMElite](https://www.cmelitegroup.com/knowledge-hub/nvidia-earnings-date-fiscal-q3-2027-report-time-guidance-and-expected-move/?nocache=1)
  - Nov 18 on other calendars.
  - Nov 25 per Earnings Whispers, which would fall outside the window. [Earnings Whispers](https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/Nvda)
  - Nvidia earnings were the trigger for last year's 28.27 high.
- **2026-11-18 (Wed):** Monthly VIX options/futures expiration, on the usual third-Wednesday schedule (not confirmed here).
- **2026-11-20 (Fri):** Monthly S&P options expiration.
- **Ongoing:**
  - Whether the AI and chip selloff continues after the midterms.
  - Asian markets: the Nikkei is in a bear market and Taiwan saw its record intraday drop.
  - The 10-year yield near 4.85%.
  - Analysts are split on whether this is a reset or the start of a downturn. [Morningstar](https://www.morningstar.com/markets/global-tech-selloff-spreads-ai-stocks-show-signs-recovery)

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-06: The Cboe VIX_History.csv (cdn-api.cboe.com) is current through Nov 6, 2026. The last row reads: open 27.68, high 27.76, low 23.47, close 25.64. [Cboe CSV](https://cdn-api.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VIX_History.csv)
- Recent HIGH values in the CSV:
  - Oct 16: 22.31
  - Oct 30: 23.93
  - Nov 2: 21.77
  - Nov 3: 21.91
  - Nov 4: 19.22
  - Nov 5: 28.36, the highest since about March 2026
  - Nov 6: 27.76

## 2. Current status
- The window (Nov 9-20, 10 trading days) has not started, so nothing is settled. The starting point is high: the VIX closed Friday at 25.64, after a 28.36 intraday high on Nov 5. If the VIX just traded near Friday's close on Monday, the period maximum would already be about 25-26.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-06: The VIX was near 24 on Friday and stocks won back some ground. Jay Woods of Freedom Capital Markets wants the VIX above 30 to confirm a real flush-out. Investors are watching the fight over Iran-war spending under a divided government, which could cause a shutdown before year-end. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/the-vix-volatility-index-just-spiked-70-heres-what-history-suggests-comes-next-125333946.html)

  - The VIX had its biggest intraday jump in more than 18 months. The trigger was a Democratic midterm sweep and its implications for data centers.

  - The Taiwan ~9% intraday drop on Nov 6 was a reaction to the US selloff on Nov 5. [UDN](https://udn.com/news/story/7251/9861110)

## 4. Base rates
- In the fall of 2026 the VIX mostly sat at 14-20. Intraday spikes faded quickly:
  - Oct 16: high 22.31, then 18.93 the next session.
  - Oct 30: high 23.93, then about 21.8 on Nov 2.
  - Nov 3: high 21.91, then 19.22 on Nov 4. [Cboe CSV](https://cdn-api.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VIX_History.csv)
- After the Nov 5 spike, Nov 6 opened at 27.68 and dropped to 23.47 intraday. That is the usual pattern: the VIX falls back after a spike, but a 10-day window that starts in the mid-20s often catches either an early print in the mid-20s or a retest of the spike.
- Same calendar window in past years (from memory, not checked this session):
  - Nov 2025: the VIX peaked intraday around 28 on about Nov 20-21, when an AI and Nvidia-related selloff reversed.
  - Nov 2024 (after the election): highs mostly around 15-18.
  - Nov 2023 and Nov 2022: VIX highs were mostly in the mid-teens to mid-20s and falling.
- Seasonality: mid-to-late November usually has falling volatility. This year starts well above the past 2-4 years at the same date, about 25.6 against roughly 15-20.
- Typical 10-day range: in stressed regimes, the gap between the first day's level and the 10-day high is often 2-8 points. Rises to 30-40+ have happened in shocks such as Aug 2024 and Apr 2025.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the VIX maximum for Nov 9-20. None of the pre-collected markets (CPI, HYPE, gas, DXY, silver and others) match this question.
- I found no VIX futures term-structure data. One source says the VIX was "above 25" going into the week. [Closing Print](https://www.theclosingprint.net/2026/11/post-market-and-weekly-summary-2026-11-06/)

- Nov 13 (Fri): October PPI.
- Nov 17 (Tue): Nvidia fiscal Q3 earnings after the close, against a revenue guide of about $108B. This is probably the biggest single catalyst for volatility. In the week after its last 13 reports, the stock fell 8 times. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/buy-nvidia-nov-17-evidence-092502652.html), [Earnings Whispers](https://www.earningswhispers.com/calweek/20261116)
- Nov 18 (Wed): monthly VIX options/futures expiration, normally the Wednesday 30 days before the third Friday of the next month (inferred, not confirmed). The November monthly SPX options expire Nov 20.
- Ongoing: the fight over Iran-war spending and the risk of a government shutdown, the policy fallout from the Democratic sweep, and the weak AI and semiconductor trade. forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** The window runs from the open on Mon Nov 9 to the close on Fri Nov 20, 2026. That is 10 trading days, and the outcome is known about 2 weeks from now.

(b) **Latest known value:** The VIX closed at 25.64 on Nov 6, 2026, with an intraday high of 27.76 that day. The year-to-date high is 28.36, set on Nov 5.

(c) **If nothing changed:** The VIX would sit around 25.6, and normal intraday ranges in this elevated regime would put the window high near 26 to 27.

(d) **If the trend continued:** The last two days point in different directions. The spike pattern points to a renewed selloff and a high above 28. The mean reversion seen in October points to fading toward 20, but the window high would still be set early, around 25 to 26.

(e) **Historical variation:**
- At a VIX level of 25, typical 10-day maximums run about 5% to 20% above the starting close.
- Tail outcomes run 50% or more above it.
- In 2025 the same window rose 48% from the prior close (19.08 to 28.27), driven by Nvidia earnings.
- In 2024 it rose 26%.
- Starting from an elevated level, mean reversion dampens the upside in percentage terms, but the first-day high puts a floor under the result.

(f) **Experts and markets:** I found no market on this quantity. VIX futures would likely be in backwardation after the spike, which implies the market expects some decay.

The main catalysts inside the window are:
- CPI on Nov 10.
- PPI on Nov 17.
- Nvidia earnings, possibly Nov 17-18, though one source places them outside the window.
